requirements.text: - Bachelor’s degree or above in Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related fields
- 1+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, or relevant internship/full-time roles.
- Solid foundation in statistics; understanding of A/B testing, hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and common analytical methods
- Proficient in SQL; able to use Python or R for data processing, basic modeling, and visualization.
- Strong structured thinking, with the ability to break business problems into analyzable and testable data questions.
- Good communication skills, with the ability to clearly present analytical process, findings, and recommendations, and a willingness to learn proactively in cross-functional collaboration.
- Experience or coursework in causal inference is a plus.
- Interest in content products, recommendation systems, creator ecosystems, or growth strategies; experience in news, content communities, recommendation, or user growth projects is a plus.
- Experience with overseas markets, or cross-region projects is a plus.
- Strong curiosity, self-drive, and learning agility; able to iterate on analytical methods and business understanding through feedback.
